# shopify_page (Resource)

An online store page: handle, title, body and template. **A poor fit for Terraform unless you bootstrap a store or keep a few pages in a repository:** page texts (imprint, about us, landing pages) are usually maintained in the admin by people outside the infrastructure team, and every admin edit to a managed attribute is reverted on the next apply. Leave `body` unset and Terraform owns the handle, title and template while editors own the text. Pages are visible on the online store only; `published` is the switch. Scheduled publishing (`publishDate`), metafield values and URL redirects are not managed: a scheduled page reads as `published = false`, and a config with `published = true` publishes it at the next apply. Destroying a page deletes it with its metafield values and translations, and menu items pointing at it may lose their target. A page that already has the handle, such as `contact` which every store has, needs `adopt_existing = true`; destroy then leaves it in place. Import with the handle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Terraform owns handle, title and template; the text stays with the editors because body is unset.
resource "shopify_page" "ueber_uns" {
  handle          = "ueber-uns"
  title           = "Über uns"
  template_suffix = "about"
}

# Page texts are a poor fit for Terraform: every admin edit to body is reverted on the next apply.
resource "shopify_page" "impressum" {
  handle    = "impressum"
  title     = "Impressum"
  body      = file("${path.module}/pages/impressum.html")
  published = true
}

# Every store has contact; adopting it manages the title, and destroy leaves it in place.
resource "shopify_page" "contact" {
  handle         = "contact"
  title          = "Kontakt"
  adopt_existing = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) The page's URL handle, unique per shop. Changing it renames the page in place and creates no URL redirect. Lower case, no whitespace: Shopify lower-cases anything else.
- `title` (String) The page title.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing page with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `body` (String) The page content as HTML. Shopify repairs malformed HTML; the configured text is kept while Shopify still holds what it returned at the last apply, so the repair is no diff, but a later admin edit is. Unset means unmanaged: the value set in the admin is kept.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the page is visible on the online store. A new page is published when this is unset. Unset means unmanaged: the value set in the admin is kept.
- `template_suffix` (String) Theme template suffix, such as `legal` for `page.legal.json`. Null and an empty string both mean the default template, and each reads back as given. Unset means unmanaged: the value set in the admin is kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Page GID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <handle>
terraform import shopify_page.impressum impressum
```
